name: OSS_USAGE_EVENT_BATCHES
description: This table is used to catch batching information about usage rating ess job.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier usage rating batch.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate identifier usage rating batch.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of Usage Events Batch

columns.name: BATCH_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Batch description of usage rating batch.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business Unit ID associated with usage Event Import Batch.

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATETIME
columns.description: Date and timestamp on which the batch got processed.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_EVENTS
columns.description: Number of usage events associated with batch.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_EVENTS_INPROCESS
columns.description: Number of usage events being processed.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_EVENTS_ERRORED
columns.description: Number of usage events with errors.

columns.name: COUNT_OF_EVENTS_PROCESSED
columns.description: Number of usage events processed successfully.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Batch status of usage rating batch.

columns.name: BATCH_PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Files used to captured process status of  usage rating batch.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRUEUP_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates whether the batch can be used for creating usage events for the true-up process.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: It records the end date of the batch.

columns.name: PRICER_TYPE
columns.description: It describes which pricer will be used for rating

columns.name: OWNER_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Party ID of the user who created the usage event batch.

columns.name: USAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Describes the type of usage batch

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE
columns.description: Describes the Schedule type of the usage batch

columns.name: RATING_PROC_SCHEDULE_DATETIME
columns.description: Date after which Batch becomes eligible for Rating

columns.name: CREATION_TYPE
columns.description: Describes the Creation type of the usage batch

columns.name: CRITERIA_JSON
columns.description: It records the criteria in JSON format.

columns.name: CRITERIA_SQL
columns.description: It records the criteria in SQL format.

columns.name: REVERSED_EVENTS_COUNT
columns.description: Records the count of events reversed in the current ReRating batch

columns.name: INCLUDE_REVERSAL_EVENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if Rerating should also include reversal events.

columns.name: PARTITION_KEY
columns.description: Column used for persisting the value of partition key for child entity tables.

columns.name: PARTITION_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number used for accessing partition wise data.

columns.name: SYSTEM_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the batch is system generated or user created.

columns.name: FILE_IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the CSV File Import Batch ID that this usage batch is associated with.

columns.name: SOURCE_INTERFACE_TYPE
columns.description: Describes the Source of Usage Event Batch.

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: This column represents the name of the currently running or last completed action done at the batch level

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: This column represents the process id of the currently running or last completed action done at the batch level

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: This column represents the status of the currently running or last completed action done at the batch level

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
